title: Proyecto Contract — Hotel Design 18
issue: Hotel Design 18, bound with Proyecto Contract 223 · masthead date 09/26 · Casual Magazines
readingOrder: Page 1 is the cover and stands alone; spreads are [2,3],[4,5]... (even page left, odd page right); page 230 is the back cover and stands alone.

fonts.interior: Caecilia (Heavy, Bold, Light, Roman; bold small-caps for credit lines)

pages.note: Front cover. Interstate masthead over a full-bleed hotel-lobby photograph; the blue band announces the bound-in Proyecto Contract 223.
Full-page advertisement (Tecsoled lighting) facing the contents page.
SUMARIO. Rust-orange vertical tab, four numbered photo thumbnails and a seven-section contents list set in Caecilia.
HALL editorial and masthead. 'Pau Monfort' is listed in the masthead under Redacción.
Full-page advertisement (Inclass furniture) facing the masthead.
SALA DE VISITAS opener. Rust-orange panel with a white pull-quote in Caecilia Heavy beside a portrait.
Interview portrait on a clean shelf wall; folio and running head in the margin.
Interview spread. Wide photo with an overlaid pull-quote, two-column Q&A and boxed project captions in rust type.
Interview continues: photo stack, serif Q&A column and a boxed caption.
OPEN SPACE opener 'Madrid entre molduras' (Mercer Hotel Madrid). Rust tab, title and standfirst over a full-bleed lobby photo.
Right half of the double-page lobby photograph.
Gran Hotel Barcino opener. Portrait-crop detail photo above a centred Caecilia headline and standfirst.
Full-height photograph of the stone courtyard.
Waldorf Astoria Seychelles opener 'Santuario en el Índico'. Double-page chandelier photo with a translucent title box; byline 'Textos: Pau Monfort.'
Right half of the double-page chandelier photograph.
Les Clarisses. Panoramic double-page image under a hanging leaf installation, with a two-column caption.
Right half of the panoramic image; small caption columns set in white.
Catalonia Plaza España opener. Full-bleed reception photo spanning both pages.
Title 'Bienestar al mando' set over the counter; byline 'Textos: Pau Monfort.'
ZONA VIP news page: rust tab, large Interstate headline and a graffiti photo for the Interihotel MAD26 fair.
Cover of the bound-in Proyecto Contract 223: blue retail-interior photograph and Interstate cover lines.
LOUNGE COLLECTION. Six mini-features in a strict grid, photos alternating left and right with hairline rules.
Grid continues: three more projects, text columns facing photos.
Lady Pipa opener 'Retail hipnótico'. Rust OPEN SPACE tab and white serif title over a blue interior.
Right half of the blue retail photograph.
Nude Project opener 'Escenografía kubrickiana'. Portrait photo over a centred headline; byline 'Textos: Pau Monfort.'
Full-height photograph of the speaker-wall arch.
ARCHIVO opener 'Materia técnica, uso exigente'. Olive field, rust tab and an illustration by Luca Deu.
Right half of the illustration.
Back cover: advertisement (Roca, Kay tap collection).

credit.text: Redacción: Pau Monfort, Ada Marqués, Cristina Medina, Pablo Estela
